org.portico.utils.logging

Class ColorConsoleAppender

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.log4j.AppenderSkeleton
      • org.apache.log4j.WriterAppender
        • org.apache.log4j.ConsoleAppender
          • org.portico.utils.logging.ColorConsoleAppender
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.apache.log4j.Appender, org.apache.log4j.spi.OptionHandler

    public class ColorConsoleAppender
extends org.apache.log4j.ConsoleAppender
    This class prints colored logging information to either Standard Error (defaut) or Standard Out. Credits: -This class is mainly based off ConsoleAppender (as found in the log4j distribution) -The meat of the color injection method comes from a class by Nicolas Martignole
